Can any part of the unused 18 Oct night be refunded?

I did nothing on the cruise or the old policy.

grade.message: Hi, family of four here. Our Delta flight DLR53A from JFK to London on 17 October got in 26 hours late because of the storm, and our 4 bags only turned up two days later, right before our cruise. We spent 380 dollars on clothes and toiletries (receipts emailed, I filed the bag report at Heathrow). Because of the delay we never used the London hotel night we prepaid through you (RNR53B, 2 rooms, 640). We did make the Royal Caribbean sailing from Southampton, thank god. Can you get the clothes money from Delta, and the hotel night back? If the hotel won't refund it, please claim it (that hotel night, RNR53B) on the Allianz insurance we bought with you for this trip. We still have an old Allianz policy from last summer too if that helps. marisol.vega@example.com, card 4417.
